summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase B (Settings refactor: 1671 -> 545 lines, 13 sub-components in /app/frontend/components/settings/) and Phase C (Training refactor: 1181 -> 257 lines, 8 sub-components + 2 hooks). E2E Playwright run on mobile viewport (390x844) using the public preview URL with admin login (etheriasystems@gmail.com / $Tory2410) + math-captcha solver (handles + and -). Pre-flight code review found ONE critical blocker which T1 fixed: app/training.tsx had `const router = useRouter()` on line 43 but `useRouter` was NOT imported from 'expo-router' AND `router` was never used downstream — this would have thrown ReferenceError on Training mount. T1 removed the dead line. After fix: ZERO red-screen errors, ZERO JS pageerrors, only 1 unrelated console 404 (resource not tied to the refactor). Results: (1) SETTINGS renders all blocks: avatar + 'Tap to change photo' + email (etheriasystems@gmail.com) + 'Premium Member' tag; Etheria Premium card with 'Active' + 'Renews on June 10, 2027' + 4 feature pills (Unlimited Oracle / Spirit Guides / AI Meditation / Voice TTS); 'Have a promotional code?' expandable row; Profile Information (Name='Etheria Dev', User ID=user_1bcd16097d5a, Edit Profile button); Theme + Language rows; all 8 contact rows (Feedback, Email Us, Visit Website, WhatsApp, Facebook, Privacy Policy, Community Guidelines, Terms); Admin Panel row; Logout red-border button; 'Version 1.0.0'. (2) Edit Profile -> Cancel works (Save+Cancel buttons surface, Cancel exits edit mode without saving). (3) ALL FIVE MODALS verified: ThemeModal slides up showing 6+ theme options (Mystic Purple/Ocean Blue/Forest Green/Sunset Orange/Midnight Black/Rose Gold) with 'Current' badge on active theme — closes via Escape/X; LanguageModal slides up showing English/Spanish/French/German/Italian/Portuguese/Japanese with native names — closes; PictureModal slides up via avatar tap (NOT via 'Tap to change photo' hint — that's just a label) showing 'Take Photo' + 'Choose from Library' + Cancel — closes; EmailModal slides up showing etheriasystems@gmail.com + 'Open Email App' — closes; LogoutModal slides up with confirmation copy — Cancel preserves session. (4) TRAINING renders TrainingHero (✦ Psychic Mastery ✦ + 'Psychic Training' + 'Develop your psychic abilities through structured lessons and guided exercises'); three ModuleSections (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced) with leaf/flame/star icons; module cards render category badge + title + description + lesson count + Free/Unlocked badge (e.g., 'Opening Your Third Eye / 5 lessons / Free'; 'Meditation Basics / 7 lessons / Unlocked'; 'Energy Awareness / 6 lessons / Unlocked'). (5) Tapping 'Opening Your Third Eye' opens LessonListModal with 5 lessons each showing 'Tap to start'; tapping 'Introduction to the Third Eye' opens LessonContentModal with rich markdown content + 'Complete & Next' button at bottom + Guided Meditation block detected in content; tapping 'Complete & Next' advances to Lesson 2 'Preparing Your Mind' cleanly. (6) No console/page errors related to any of: . The Phase B + Phase C refactor is behavior-preserving.
action_items: FIXED by T1: /app/frontend/app/training.tsx line 43 — removed dead `const router = useRouter();` (useRouter was never imported, would have crashed Training screen with ReferenceError). No further main-agent action needed for this — fix verified at runtime: Training screen renders and is fully interactive.

OPTIONAL (already 'best-effort' by design — not blocking): the 1 console 404 observed during testing is `POST /api/training/lesson-complete` -> 404 fired from useTrainingProgress.ts (lines 56 and 96). The hook's header docstring explicitly labels this call best-effort and AsyncStorage is the source of truth, so lesson completion still works end-to-end (verified: 'Complete & Next' advanced Lesson 1 -> Lesson 2 with no UI failure; the parallel POST /api/journal/entries returned 200). Main agent may want to either (a) add the missing /api/training/lesson-complete backend endpoint OR (b) silence the fetch with a catch-and-ignore that doesn't surface a console.error. This was NOT introduced by Phase C — it pre-existed and migrated into the hook.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx is now 545 lines (target <700) — clean orchestrator pattern. All state and handlers stay in the parent and are forwarded as props to focused sub-components in /app/frontend/components/settings/.

training.tsx is now 257 lines (target <700) — excellent. Module list fetch, modal visibility, and lesson dispatch stay in the parent; presentation lives in /app/frontend/components/training/; effectful behaviors (progress tracking + TTS) extracted into custom hooks (/app/frontend/hooks/useTrainingProgress.ts, useTrainingMeditation.ts).
commonStyles.ts correctly centralizes the modal/section/setting-row styles used across all 13 settings sub-components — eliminates the previous duplication.

HeaderCard.tsx: only the avatar TouchableOpacity opens the picture picker — the 'Tap to change photo' Text is a non-interactive hint. Not a bug, but consider wrapping the hint in a Pressable too so the hint area itself triggers the picker (better touch target).
PictureModal.tsx Take Photo / Choose from Library tiles call onClose() THEN the action — good pattern, prevents the modal from staying mounted while the system picker animates in.

useTrainingProgress.ts + useTrainingMeditation.ts: hooks own their AsyncStorage / TTS audio refs and expose only a small API surface (saveProgress / isLessonCompleted; playMeditation / stopMeditation / isPlayingMeditation / isGeneratingTTS / ttsProgress). Clean separation of concerns.

BUG FIXED: training.tsx had a stale `const router = useRouter();` reference left over from the pre-refactor file. Since 'useRouter' was never imported and 'router' was never used, the line was both a compile-error-equivalent (ReferenceError) and dead code. T1 removed it.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is read once at module top in both files (no per-render env lookups). Good.

rca_of_issue: Bug: training.tsx line 43 contained `const router = useRouter();` left behind from the pre-refactor file. After the Phase C extraction, none of the navigation logic that previously needed `router` remained in this file — it had all moved into LessonListModal / LessonContentModal which receive close handlers as props. However, the `useRouter()` invocation itself was not removed, and the matching `import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'` line was. Reproduction: navigate to /training on web — the screen would throw a ReferenceError ('useRouter is not defined') on mount, rendering blank. Metro bundling did NOT catch this because Metro does not run TypeScript type-checking by default during bundling. Mitigation applied: T1 deleted the dead line in /app/frontend/app/training.tsx. Verification: Training screen now mounts, fetches modules, renders TrainingHero + all three ModuleSections + module cards + LessonListModal + LessonContentModal end-to-end with zero pageerrors and zero console errors related to the refactored components.
